notes:
TL;DR: Mid-market product analytics SaaS evaluating Redwood Hosted API for embeddings + semantic search POC; likely move to Dedicated for committed nightly batch throughput and lower unit cost.

Timeline / recent activity:
- 2025-11-12: Intro call (AE: Samantha) — high level needs: better in-app search for product docs + user sessions; want sub-100ms query latency for product search UI.
- 2025-11-18: Hosted API demo (embeddings + single vector search) — walked through SDK + streaming examples. SE (Miguel) showed batching options and cost tradeoffs.
- 2025-11-21: POC kickoff — ingest sample of 200k docs (mix docs, transcripts, product events) into Pinecone; Redwood Hosted embeddings used for initial vectors.
- 2025-11-26: Bulk embed run (hosted) — measured sustained throughput ~18k embeddings/hour with current batch size; cost projection for 1.2M corpus ~ $8.5k/mo on hosted.
- 2025-11-30: Scale test — online query p50 ~ 28ms, p95 ~ 120ms (goal p95 <150ms). p99 spikes at ~340ms under simulated peak (250 qps).
- 2025-12-01: Security questionnaire submitted (SOC2 attestation required; SSO via SAML mandatory; EU data residency for EU users).
- 2025-12-02: Pricing review call — AE reviewed Dedicated committed capacity pricing vs hosted. Customer interested in Dedicated if price delta for nightly batch / embedding jobs is >30% cheaper and SLAs for p99 latency available.

Use-case details & technical requirements:
- Primary: semantic search across product docs, support transcripts, and indexed event summaries for analyst workflows. Secondary: reranking for in-app recommendations.
- Corpus size (target): 1.2M documents/tokens (initial POC sampling 200k). Daily delta ~40k docs. Nightly embedding batch required; target nightly embedding throughput 50k-100k embeddings/hour (goal: finish batch within 12 hours).
- Online query profile: ~200-300 qps peak to app microservice, average top-k search k=10. SLOs: p50 < 30ms, p95 < 150ms, p99 < 200ms (hard).
- Vector DB: currently using Pinecone for POC; evaluating Milvus and managed solutions. Want Redwood to support direct integration or provide a managed vector store option.
- Integration points: existing infra in GCP (us-central), require VPC peering for Dedicated and private networking for ingestion jobs.

Security & compliance notes:
- Must pass SOC2 review; legal asked about audit logs retention and exportability.
- Customer prefers customer-managed KMS for encryption-at-rest for Dedicated.
- Data residency: EU subset of users' documents must remain in eu-west-1; Redwood asked about region routing/fallback.

POC metrics being tracked (customer-facing):
- Embedding throughput (embeds/hr), cost per 1k embeddings, time to complete nightly batch.
- Query latency distribution under synthetic load (p50/p95/p99).
- Recall @10 and MRR for seeded queries (QA set of 400 queries).

Commercials & next steps:
- Shortlist: Hosted API for short term to finish POC; Dedicated if cost + latency prove out. Customer asked for a Dedicated proposal with committed monthly capacity + optional burst; wants 12-month pricing.
- Next calls: 2025-12-07 deep-dive on Dedicated networking + KMS flow (SE + infra). 2025-12-10 pricing review with finance.
- Blockers: finance needs clearer TCO comparison (hosted vs dedicated) with actual POC numbers; engineering needs validated connector for Milvus (current Pinecone connector stable).

- Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching and quantization for embedding batch jobs to reduce cost.
